description.value: The SFU Aquatic Centre is an indoor swimming facility operated by Simon Fraser University on its Burnaby Mountain campus, open to the public. As a university aquatic centre, it offers competitive-length pool swimming in a setting accessible to community members and visitors. Touring cyclists tackling the climb to SFU may find it a useful rest stop with facilities typical of a university rec centre.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 63m; rack (covered) at 64m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM-provided website URL (a 2021 private swim lessons page on sfurec.ca) returned a 404 Not Found, so no website content is available; all amenity fields rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms an indoor SFU-operated swimming facility with public access (access=yes), but provides no detail on cycling-specific amenities. The community tag 'North Vancouver' appears geographically incorrect, as SFU's main campus sits on Burnaby Mountain in Burnaby.
concerns: OSM website URL (https://sfurec.ca/sports/2021/5/18/private-swim-lessons.aspx) returns 404 Not Found -- the page no longer exists; the root domain sfurec.ca likely has current information.
Community tag lists 'North Vancouver' but SFU's main campus is in Burnaby (Burnaby Mountain) -- location/community data may be incorrect.
No address or phone number in OSM record; no website content available to supplement.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The SFU Aquatic Centre is a real, publicly accessible facility (OSM access=yes, looks_closed=false). It is a legitimate attraction and rest stop for touring cyclists on the Burnaby Mountain climb.
enrichment_extras.notes: All amenity fields are null due to website fetch failure (404). A re-fetch against the sfurec.ca homepage or the current recreation centre page would likely yield confirmable amenity data.
